Specification: A specification of the Paxos algorithm without explicit leaders or learners. Acceptors exchange phase 1a/1b/2a/2b messages over a shared msgs set; the spec refines the high-level Voting specification via the V!INSTANCE refinement mapping (votes/maxBal). Includes an inductive invariant Inv combining TypeOK with refinement-mapping properties on messages.
IfThenElse: IF maxVBal[a] = -1 THEN maxVal[a] = None ELSE <<maxVBal[a], maxVal[a]>> \in votes[a]
SetEnumeration: {m \in msgs : /\ m.type = "1b" /\ m.acc \in Q /\ m.bal = b}
{<<m.bal, m.val>> : m \in {mm \in msgs: /\ mm.type = "2b" /\ mm.acc = a }}
FunctionConstructor: [a \in Acceptor |-> {<<m.bal, m.val>> : m \in {mm \in msgs: /\ mm.type = "2b" /\ mm.acc = a }}]
RecordConstructor: [type : {"1b"}, acc : Acceptor, bal : Ballot, mbal : Ballot \cup {-1}, mval : Value \cup {None}]
[type : {"2b"}, acc : Acceptor, bal : Ballot, val : Value]
[type |-> "1b", acc |-> a, bal |-> m.bal, mbal |-> maxVBal[a], mval |-> maxVal[a]]
[type |-> "2b", acc |-> a, bal |-> m.bal, val |-> m.val]
FunctionConstructor_ByDomain: [a \in Acceptor |-> {<<m.bal, m.val>> : m \in {mm \in msgs: /\ mm.type = "2b" /\ mm.acc = a }}]
DivisionNotes: TypeOK and Inv are placed in OperatorDefNames_StatePredicate as they are conjunctions of state-level constraints (\in / \subseteq, IF/THEN/ELSE on state) without primed variables.
Spec is the only top-level temporal definition (Init /\ [][Next]_vars) and is placed in OperatorDefNames_TemporalProperty.
Init is the named initial-state predicate of the form var = value /\ ... and is placed in OperatorDefNames_Init.
Send, Phase1a, Phase1b, Phase2a, Phase2b, Next are placed in ActionDefNames because they contain primed variables (msgs', maxBal', etc.) or disjunctions of actions.

Ballot, None, Message, vars, votes are placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef as they define structural values: a constant set, a CHOOSE-defined value, a record-set definition, a tuple of variables, and a state function.
FunctionConstructor entries with [x \in Domain |-> body] are partitioned into FunctionConstructor_ByDomain; [Domain -> Range] entries are placed in FunctionConstructor_SetType.
All UNCHANGED expressions reference explicit tuples of variables, so all entries are in UnchangedExprs_Explicit; UnchangedExprs_VarRef is empty.
TemporalNesting is false: only [][Next]_vars appears (no nested temporal operators).
VerificationTools is empty: the module does NOT extend TLC and uses no TLC-specific operators (the module is named Paxos.tla, the model-checking harness lives in MCPaxos).
